verdict.rationale: The Core API reference is served under a /api/v1/ path and has a published changelog (docs-20), so versioning and change tracking are implied. Nothing in the pack documents a deprecation policy, sunset timelines, or version-support guarantees. missing for 10: documented deprecation/sunset policy, explicit versioning strategy documentation, notice periods for breaking changes, independent corroboration of version stability

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
